You are the test planner of a network change-validation pipeline. Given the change ticket, the
intent analysis and the configuration diff, write a change-specific test plan that (a) checks every effect the ticket
promises and (b) checks that nothing else that the diff could affect has changed (use expect "unchanged").
Also consider emulation-only risks: MTU (mtu probes), failover timers (conv), link load after path changes (load).
Typed test language (JSON objects; use ONLY these types and only names that exist):
  {"t":"reach","src":HOST,"dst":HOST|ROUTER,"svc":SVC|"*","expect":"allow"|"deny"|"unchanged"}
  {"t":"path","src":HOST,"dst":HOST,"via":ROUTER,"expect":true|false}
  {"t":"route","dev":ROUTER,"prefix":"a.b.c.d/n","expect":"present"|"absent"|"unchanged"}
  {"t":"adj","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"expect":"up"|"down"|"unchanged"}          (OSPF adjacency on a link)
  {"t":"mtu","src":HOST,"dst":HOST,"size":1500|9000,"expect":"pass"|"fail"}  (DF probe, emulation tier)
  {"t":"conv","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"max_s":3}                               (failover time of a link, emulation)
  {"t":"load","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"max_pct":90}                            (link utilisation, emulation)
  {"t":"like","host":HOST,"as":HOST}     (after a VLAN move / re-addressing: host has exactly the same access as the
                                          reference host, towards and from every other host and service)
SVC is one of: icmp, tcp/22, tcp/25, tcp/80, tcp/443, tcp/5432, udp/53.
Reply with JSON only: {"tests": [ ... ]}

text:
The target 172.16.2.66/32 falls inside the cust2 subnet (c2-host is 172.16.2.10, so the target is a neighbouring address, not a known host). The null0 route should cause drops at PAO and PIT, which are the border routers facing peer2 and peer1. Everything else, including the rest of the 172.16.2.0/24 subnet, must stay unaffected.

```json
{"tests": [
  {"t":"route","dev":"PAO","prefix":"172.16.2.66/32","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"PIT","prefix":"172.16.2.66/32","expect":"present"},

  {"t":"route","dev":"PAO","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"PIT","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"SEA","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"ATL","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"SEA","prefix":"172.16.2.66/32","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"ATL","prefix":"172.16.2.66/32","expect":"unchanged"},

  {"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns2","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"c2-host","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"c2-host","dst":"ext-dns2","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"c1-host","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"c3-host","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"c1-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns2","dst":"c3-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"PAO","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"PIT","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},

  {"t":"adj","a":"PAO","b":"SEA","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PAO","b":"SLC","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PAO","b":"SDG","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"CHM","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"ATL","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"ITH","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"CPK","expect":"unchanged"},

  {"t":"mtu","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"c2-host","size":1500,"expect":"pass"},
  {"t":"mtu","src":"c2-host","dst":"ext-dns2","size":1500,"expect":"pass"},

  {"t":"load","a":"PAO","b":"peer2","max_pct":90},
  {"t":"load","a":"PIT","b":"peer1","max_pct":90},
  {"t":"load","a":"PAO","b":"SLC","max_pct":90},
  {"t":"load","a":"PIT","b":"CHM","max_pct":90}
]}
```

Notes on the plan:
- The positive checks confirm the /32 null route is installed on both borders.
- The target is not a named host, so its drop behaviour is verified via the route entries. Reachability to c2-host (172.16.2.10) must stay unchanged, since a /32 must not capture the rest of the /24.
- The unchanged route checks on interior routers confirm the null route is not leaking into the IGP or redistributed.
- Adjacency, MTU and load checks cover regressions and the emulation-tier risks.
